description: Book a tour session or Bike On rental for the customer. The booking is made unpaid and holds the places for 30 minutes; the customer must pay with the payment link returned, on our secure booking page (no card details are ever taken here). Unpaid bookings are cancelled automatically. Needs the customer's confirmation of the details and their agreement to the booking terms.

adults.description: Adults (on kayak tours: anyone 13 and over)

children.description: Children (kayak tours: ages 4 to 12). Bike tours have no child rate.

customer.description: Field values by key from get_booking_form (customer_name, customer_email, customer_phone and any others it requires)

customer_agreed_to_terms.description: True only if the customer has read and agreed to the booking terms

customer_confirmed_details.description: True only if the customer confirmed tour, date, time, numbers and price

guests.description: Optional: exact counts by the guest_types keys that check_availability returns. Overrides adults/children/infants.

infants.description: Infants and toddlers aged 3 and under (kayak tours)

rental.description: For Bike On bike rentals instead of a tour.

bikes.description: The bikes to hire, one entry per size

qty.description: How many bikes of this size

delivery_suburb.description: Optional: suburb to deliver to and collect from. Leave out to collect from the shop.

end_date.description: Last day of hire, YYYY-MM-DD (same as start_date for one day)

name: create_booking
title: Hold a booking (unpaid, 30 minutes)
